q: In the morning when thou findest thyself unwilling to rise, consider... it is to go about a man's work that I am stirred up.
Remember how long thou hast already put off these things...
our life is short; we must endeavour to gain the present time with best discretion and justice.
thy mind... becometh altogether unconquerable, when once recollected in herself
The best kind of revenge is, not to become like unto them.
